artworks.title: The Abduction of Europa
artworks.description: Rembrandt's Europa on the bull — the princess Asterius of Crete will marry after Zeus leaves her, raising Minos, Rhadamanthys and Sarpedon as his foster-sons.

artworks.title: The Rape of Europa
artworks.description: Titian's poesie: Europa carried to Crete — the island where Asterius (Asterion) becomes her mortal husband and the boys' foster-father. Not Asterius the Minotaur, nor the Thessalian Argonaut.
